title: Tilting Tiles
statement: An h-by-w grid holds colored tiles on some of its cells; tilting the board left, right, up or down slides every tile as far as it can go in that direction, and tiles of the same color are indistinguishable. Given a starting arrangement and a target arrangement, decide whether any finite sequence of tilts turns the first into the second, for grids as large as 500 by 500.
